en:
#sname#, tell me a topic and I'll
survey the supporters about it, then
rank the results. Which topic?

Here are the results of this survey.
We can look at other topics next time.

Here's what the supporters told us.
Statistically, the more supporters
there are, the more accurate it is.

No real complaints, it seems.
Perhaps we're looking after the
Supporters' every need.

That's a little worrying.
With the future in mind, it might be
best to act sooner rather than later.

They seem quite insistent.
Unless we take it seriously, it could
cause trouble for running the club.

The supporters are very unhappy.
It feels like a powder keg.
We should act quickly.

I'll ask the supporters what they
think of the club's players.
We can look into even fine details.

I'll ask the supporters for opinions
and complaints about the club's
facilities. Check in often, okay?

You can create chants and assign
them according to the match situation.

If the stadium were a bit bigger,
everyone could get in.

Make the stadium bigger, please.
It's hard enough getting tickets.

Expand the stadium!
Like you don't want us watching!

A roof would be nice. We could
relax even when it rains...

Put a roof on it, at least.
Carrying rain gear is a pain.

Put a roof up! You expect us to
watch soaked to the skin?

Hmm, a restaurant would be great
when you get hungry.

A stadium this size should have
at least a restaurant, surely?

Build a restaurant, will you!
Can't cheer on an empty stomach.

A ramen shop would be perfect
for a snack when you're peckish.

Nothing beats post-match ramen.
Build us a shop, eh?

Build us a ramen shop!
Every stadium has one!

A coffee shop would be handy
for meeting up with people.

I'd like a coffee shop, somewhere
to savour the match afterwards.

Build us a coffee shop!
This stadium's so inconsiderate.

A fast food place would be good
for eating during the match.

No fast food? That's rare for a
modern stadium.

Fast food is a must, isn't it?
Just build one already!

An ice cream shop would please
the kids and the girls.

When a match heats up, I'd love
some ice cream.

Build an ice cream shop!
Are you ignoring what we want?

For family trips we'd drive,
but where would we park?

A stadium without a car park is
rare nowadays. Please build one.

Build a car park!
Can't you manage even that?

A games arcade would be nice when
there's time before the match.

With a games arcade we could use
our time well...

Build a games arcade!
Ignoring the supporters' views?

As a supporter, I'd like to buy
merchandise at the stadium.

Never seen a stadium without
a merchandise shop.

Build a merch shop, at least!
Every stadium has one, you know.

After all that cheering, a rest
area would be nice.

I'd like a rest area.
Cheering is tiring, you know.

Build a rest area! We cheer our
hearts out. Don't you notice?

I've no complaints right now.
A good stadium, I think.

It's not a bad stadium.
I always look forward to coming.

It's a good stadium, isn't it?
I'm glad I became a supporter.
